rows.check: C4 fix verified: bundle test red pre-fix, green post-fix (pytest)
rows.path_line: no behavioral production change to revert (test-only or docs-only patch)

rows.check: T2 security-relevant change also updates the threat model
T3 runtime: the whole nl-shell pytest suite on the patched worktree
rows.path_line: T3 FAIL — nl-shell suite red (pytest exit 1)

rows.check: T4 PR body has a user-impact opener + tracker id in both artifacts
rows.path_line: pr-description.md not drafted yet — the substantive T4 audit of the contribution artifacts runs at publish

rows.check: T4 host docs checks: immutability, checker tests, links, and ADR index
rows.oracle: bash -o pipefail -c 'set -euo pipefail; python3 -I -m unittest discover -s .github/docs-check -v; index=/tmp/pdca-host-docs-index-$$; test ! -e "$index"; trap "unlink \"$index\" 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT; export GIT_INDEX_FILE=$index; git read-tree HEAD; git apply --cached "$PDCA_BUNDLE/patch.diff"; base=$(git rev-parse HEAD); tree=$(git write-tree); patched=$(printf "pdca host docs\n" | git -c user.name=PDCA -c user.email=pdca@invalid commit-tree "$tree" -p "$base"); git show "${base}:scripts/docs_checks.py" | python3 -I - immutability "$base" "$patched"; git show "${base}:.github/docs-check/docs_links.py" | python3 -I -; git show "${base}:.github/docs-check/adr_index.py" | python3 -I -'
